compiled_state.description: ## Testing Mode UPDATE ## Story DD Coverage This task satisfies the adversarial review requirement: - ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: harvest-worktree.sh no longer requires test-gate-status or review-status as gate artifacts ## Implementation Plan Update `plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh`: 1. Remove the test-gate-status check block (lines ~158-193):    - Remove the `! -f "$WORKTREE_ARTIFACTS_DIR/test-gate-status"` guard    - Remove the TEST_GATE_STATUS read and all conditional logic around it    - Remove the red-marker-exempt rewrite logic 2. Remove the review-status check block (lines ~196-222):    - Remove the `! -f "$WORKTREE_ARTIFACTS_DIR/review-status"` guard    - Remove the REVIEW_STATUS read and all conditional logic around it 3. Update the --attest section (lines ~289+) to remove references to gate artifact attestation 4. Update exit code 2 documentation (line ~18) — "Gate verification failed" no longer applies 5. Update the script's top-level comment (lines ~3-4) to remove "gate artifacts" language Update `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/harvest-attestation-format.md`: - Remove test-gate-status and review-status fields from the attestation contract - Document that harvest now attests only to merge success, not gate status Update `tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree.sh`: - Remove test cases that assert harvest-worktree.sh exits 2 when gate artifacts are missing - Update any test cases that verify gate artifact behavior - Ensure the remaining tests cover the simplified harvest flow ## Test Approach Given: harvest-worktree.sh has been updated to not require gate artifacts When: harvest-worktree.sh is invoked on a worktree without test-gate-status or review-status files Then: harvest succeeds (exit 0) rather than failing with exit 2 ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh - [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] harvest-worktree.sh no longer references test-gate-status or review-status files   Verify: ! grep -qE 'test-gate-status|review-status' plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh - [ ] harvest-attestation-format.md updated to remove gate artifact fields   Verify: ! grep -qE 'test-gate-status|review-status' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/harvest-attestation-format.md - [ ] test-harvest-worktree.sh does not have tests asserting exit 2 on missing gate artifacts   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: Triage close (orphan cleanup 2026-06-02): SUPERSEDED / won't-do. This task removed the test-gate-status / review-status gate-artifact requirements from harvest-worktree.sh — part of the same local-enforcement-removal line as 6f23. Parent story 5428-bebd is DELETED, epic 1083-fb3d is CLOSED, and harvest-worktree.sh still enforces these gate artifacts by design. Removing the guards now weakens active safeguards (rule:no-safeguard-edits) for an abandoned line of work. Closing as obsolete; reopen if local-gate removal is revived.
